# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_acceleration

Configures web content acceleration for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/acceleration`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_acceleration` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_acceleration" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status             = true
    css_minify         = true
    html_minify        = true
    html_css2head      = true
    html_combine_heads = false
    js_minify          = true

    # Omit this ownership wrapper to preserve the complete remote exception_list.
    # Keep the wrapper but remove every item block to explicitly send [].
    exception_list {
      item {
        host_status = true
        host        = "static.example.com"
        url_pattern = "^/assets/"
        url_type    = "regex"
      }

      item {
        host_status = false
        url_pattern = "/health-check"
        url_type    = "string"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed web content acceleration configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_acceleration` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_acceleration.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
